before_you_start: Turn spoiler protection ON in this tracker before your first session if you want story trophy names and descriptions hidden until you earn them; it is on by default.
No difficulty setting affects trophies: the official list contains no difficulty trophy, so choose the settings that make the game most enjoyable and change them freely.
Plan for one playthrough: the roadmap is built so a single story run, followed by free-roam cleanup, earns everything, provided the missables are handled in Stages 1 and 2.

Whether the game offers chapter select or mission replay is not stated in the official list, so plan as if it does not: keep manual saves at chapter ends and before strand finals, as the missables strategy describes. That phrasing is planning advice, not a claim about the game's features.
Start the long counters in your first hours — vehicle discoveries, WAiNK locations, stunts and choices — because counters fed from the start never need a grind at the end.

difficulty.detail: This is an estimate, clearly labelled as one, based on GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 trophy-design precedent (Rockstar Games, 2013 and 2018). The reasoning: the official list contains no difficulty trophy at all, so nothing must be beaten on a hard mode; it has one 100 percent completion gold, which sets the length; and several long but simple counters — 250 stunts, 100 WAiNK locations, 100 vehicles, 500 choices and the money totals — which set the patience required. Skill concentrates in one place, the shooting-range golds. A completionist who starts the counters early should land near the low end of the hours estimate; a player who starts them at cleanup should expect the high end.
difficulty.label: Editorial estimate

missables_strategy.detail: Eleven trophies in this guide are flagged missable, and one habit defeats nearly all of them: keep a manual save before each chapter's end and never overwrite your only save. Never overwrite your only save after a strand's final mission becomes available — finish the strand first, because strand finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) and the eight-strand silver that depends on them are the easiest content to leave behind. Do the partner trophies, Hot Together and Retail Therapy, while the partner is around during the story, not in the endgame. Take Bret's unique-animal hunt when it is offered, and use story visits for the place-specific acts at VCIA and the vehicle showroom. Finally, check the Missables view in this tracker before starting the final mission, and again before you call the run finished.
rules: Keep a manual save before each chapter's end; never overwrite your only save.
Finish a strand's final mission before advancing the story past it.
Do partner trophies while the partner is travelling with you.
Take one-off hunts and place-specific acts when the story offers them.
Check the Missables view before the final mission.
missables_strategy.title: Missables strategy

online_split.detail: All 55 trophies in this official list are offline, single-player trophies: not one description mentions online play, other players, a crew or a network feature, and the two social trophies on the list concern your in-game partner, not another human. The platinum therefore needs no online play, no subscription and no boosting partner. If future downloadable content adds trophy lists, those would be separate lists and are not part of these 55.
online_split.title: Online / offline split

stages.detail: Play the story in order from Gone Fishing to the final mission, enjoying it with spoiler protection on — this tracker hides unearned story trophies by default, so let it. While the partner is travelling with you, take the two partner trophies, Hot Together and Retail Therapy, because they depend on story-era company. Start the passive counters now (vehicles, stunts, choices) and keep a manual save at each chapter's end.
stages.goal: Finish the campaign: every chapter, every named mission, and the final mission.
stages.title: Story first
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

stages.detail: Strands are Stage 2 because they are the missable heart of the list. Finish the finals for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — each is its own bronze — plus enough further strands to reach the eight that Strangers & Freaks counts, and take Bret's unique-animal hunt for Fair Game while you are in strand country. If a strand pauses, advance in-game time and check the map again rather than assuming it ended.
stages.goal: Complete eight stranger strands, including all five named strand finals.
stages.title: Strands & side stories

stages.detail: This stage earns A Long Road, the completion gold. Clear the activity family in batches: gold medals in all shooting-range challenges, 250 stunts, twenty different race wins, a drone-race win at every Top Fun location, Cal's fishing challenge, one arcade game, and a first try of every activity type for Master of None. Explore all of Leonida and meditate at every spot as you travel between activities, and take the Ocean Beach cocktail early in the stage for a breather.
stages.goal: Drive completion to 100 percent through activities and exploration.
stages.title: The 100% push

stages.detail: Hunt by focus, not by wander: complete three collectible card sets one at a time, WAiNK at 100 locations, discover 100 vehicles and register ten of them to the Scooter Bros app, complete 50 challenges, and make sure the 500 choice actions tracked by Actions Speak Louder are accumulating — check its tracked count and grind cheap repeatable choices if it lags. Most of this stage should already be half done from Stages 1 to 3; this is where you finish it deliberately.
stages.goal: Close the sets and feed every long counter to its target.
stages.title: Collectibles & counters

stages.detail: Stage 5 is the underworld economy working as one system. Rob the jewelry store undetected, five bank vaults with clean escapes, an armored truck, and one illegal operation for each gang; launder marked bills through your contacts until laundered earnings reach 250,000 dollars; spend 100,000 dollars across shops as you go; and buy all eight garage properties with the proceeds. Plan every getaway before the robbery starts — escapes, not entries, are what these trophies count.
stages.goal: Run the crime economy: robberies in, laundered money out, garages bought.
stages.title: Money & property

stages.detail: What remains is the odd and the specific: the cryptic-description trophies — Challenging Tank, Personal Best, Bad Luck I Guess and The Truth Is Out There — whose guides in this app label their readings as inferences and suggest experiments from a reloadable save; the technique trophies, Gunslinger and Ten Pin; the place-specific acts at VCIA and the showroom; and a bowling game at the Kolt & Associates alley. When the last of the 54 falls, Vice Got a Price! awards the platinum automatically.
stages.goal: Sweep the cryptic and leftover trophies, then take the platinum.
stages.title: Cleanup & platinum
